task.title: How to Connect to the NC State VPN
task.shortdesc: Learn how to connect to NC State's virtual private network (VPN) using the Cisco Secure Client and Duo authentication.

taskbody.prereq: Before you connect to the NC State VPN, make sure that the Cisco Secure Client has been installed on your device. If you haven't installed the Cisco Secure Client, see How to Install the NC State VPN Client.
taskbody.context: The NC State VPN allows students, faculty, and staff to securely access university resources and sensitive information. When connecting to the VPN, you will need to ensure that you select the correct VPN group for your affiliation or needs, and complete the Duo two-factor authentication.

step.cmd: Open the Cisco Secure Client app.

image.alt: The Cisco Secure Client window showing vpn.ncsu.edu in the server address field.

step.cmd: Select the appropriate VPN group for your needs and affiliation.
Enter your Unity ID in the Username field and your Unity password in the Password field.
In the second password field, enter one of the following to initiate Duo Two Factor Authentication:

ul.li: Enter "push" into the second password field to receive a Duo Push. Be sure to check the Duo Mobile app for the push.
Enter a code generated from the Duo Mobile app.

step.cmd: Select OK and wait for the Cisco Secure Client to connect to the NC State network.

taskbody.result:
The Cisco Secure Client will establish a connection to the NC State secure VPN network after successful authentication.
Keep the Cisco Secure Client open in order to maintain the VPN connection.
